text.p: These are the headlines for selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Eaton empire in peril: Scheme adopted by retail giant allows it to close stores, lay off workers.
- Citizens can sue MLA's over fibs: B.C. government stands accused.
- Arafat seeks united voice: Palestinian foes join in dialogue.
- Sex scandal at Gardens no secret, police believe: No indication front office knew, however, detective says.
- British Tories frown on trial by jury: Proposal would cut court time, save money, Home Secretary says.
- Eaton's drowning in red ink: Documents reveal heavy losses; retailer reels from C$120-million hit.
- First digital DTH service set for launch: AlphaStar says French, English programs available in week.
- Brokerages should disclose trading to clients: report.
- Hibernia construction milestone reached: Process to join platform pieces begins.
- Crushing debt forces Eaton's into bankruptcy protection: Thousands could lose their jobs as chain restructures to survive.
